logo_usage.clear_space: Guide page 4 draws the boxed logo in a 125 px square with 16 px border radius and a clear zone marked X; no numeric value for X is given.
logo_usage.background_rules: Works best on a white background and should be used in colour. On white backgrounds the slogan is primary blue in uppercase, with the rounded-corner square suggested alongside the slogan. Dark backgrounds always require the boxed logo: the rounded-corner square with a white background and the slogan in white. The logo with white typeface is for promotional material on dark backgrounds only. A black version is for applications where colours cannot be reproduced.
logo_usage.misuse: Do not use outlines, shadows or 3D effects; do not change the colours or typography; do not distort or rotate; avoid artistic effects and clutter around the logo; use only official versions; no new or alternative logos.

notes: Colour names are descriptive; the guide labels neither swatch. Colour and typeface values were checked against guide page 7 and the brand page; logo rules against pages 4 and 5 and the brand page. Templates in the guide also set edition metadata in Roboto Regular 9pt, which is not one of the three main typefaces.
